Bryant University women's soccer to host Maine in America East matchup Thursday
Bryant University's women's soccer team will host Maine at Beirne Stadium on October 22 for an America East Conference matchup. The Bulldogs look to improve their series record as they face last year's four-time defending champions.
The Bryant University women's soccer team will return to Beirne Stadium on Oct. 22 to face the University of Maine in an America East Conference matchup, with kickoff scheduled for 7:00 p.m.
This game marks the 15th all-time meeting between Bryant and UMaine. The Bulldogs currently trail in the series, holding a record of 3-10-1 against the Black Bears. Last season's contest ended in a 1-1 tie, with Colleen Ardolino scoring Bryant's lone goal.
Bryant enters the matchup with an overall record of 4-6-3 and a conference record of 2-2-1. Shannon Mejia recently logged five saves against UAlbany and is ranked third in the America East for shutouts this season with six. Samantha Zaslaw leads the Bulldogs offensively, tallying eleven points on five goals and one assist, and has converted all three penalty kick attempts this year.
UMaine comes into Thursday's game at 6-4-3 overall and holds a conference mark of 3-1-1. The Black Bears are four-time defending America East champions. Isabella Meadows leads UMaine with seven goals this season, tying her for first place in goals within the conference. Goalkeeper Elena Barenburg is second among conference players for goals against average at .92.
The match will be available to watch on ESPN+ and live statistics can be followed through Sidearm.
